latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Universal order and shipment tracking for Claude, powered by Ship24 — 2,500+ couriers and eCommerce platforms worldwide.                                                               
  - Track any order or package by tracking number — auto-detects carrier across 2,500+ couriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS, China Post, and thousands more).                                                  
  - Create and manage persistent trackers for ongoing order monitoring; supports single and bulk registration (up to 100 at once).                                                                        
  - Retrieve full order tracking history, delivery milestones, and live status on demand.                                                                                                                 
  - One-off order status lookups without saving a tracker — ideal for quick queries or per-call billing plans.                                                                                            
  - Subscribe to webhook notifications per order and replay missed delivery events.                                                                                                                       
  - Reference trackers by your own order IDs or internal keys alongside Ship24's native tracker IDs.
